name: departs-mcp
description: Real-time Czech and Slovak public transit departures, live vehicle locations, traffic alerts, and route details for Prague (PID), Brno (IDS JMK) and Prešov (DPMP).

tools.name: search_stops
tools.description: Search public transit stops/stations by name or ID in Prague, Brno or Prešov.

tools.name: search_nearest_stops
tools.description: Find public transit stops/stations closest to geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude).

tools.name: get_next_departures
tools.description: Get real-time upcoming transit departures from a stop.

tools.name: get_nearest_departures
tools.description: Get real-time upcoming departures for stops closest to geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude).

tools.name: get_realtime_vehicles
tools.description: Get live vehicle positions, current delays, and status.

tools.name: get_service_alerts
tools.description: Get active transit service disruptions, closures, detours, and news alerts.

tools.name: get_vehicle_detail
tools.description: Get detailed itinerary and stop schedule progress for a specific vehicle or trip.
